name: Business of Loving
source:
Business of Loving is a NSFW visual novel of love, lust, and getting down to business. You play as a young unpaid intern, trying to make it in the biggest company in the city, Business Inc! You'll not only have to balance your life dealing with your grueling boss Kimberly, but you'll also have to balance home life with your single mother Lorraine, as well as find other part-time jobs with various other bosses to pay rent on time, such as Lily, the sweet gardener and Ramirez, the novice police officer. Uncover a scandal of dirty lies and kinky corruption as you slowly make your way to the top of the business empire!

[From [url=https://dead-end-draws.itch.io/business-of-loving-special-edition]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《Business of Loving》是一部围绕爱情、欲望与职场打拼展开的成人视觉小说。你将扮演一名年轻的无薪实习生，努力在全市最大的公司Business Inc.闯出一番天地！你既要应付苛刻的上司金伯莉，也要兼顾与单亲母亲洛兰的家庭生活，还得寻找其他兼职，才能按时支付房租。你会遇见不同的雇主，例如温柔的园丁莉莉，以及新手警员拉米雷斯。在一步步爬上商业帝国顶端的过程中，揭开肮脏谎言与情色堕落交织的丑闻！

[摘自[url=https://dead-end-draws.itch.io/business-of-loving-special-edition]itch.io[/url]]
